## About me...

My name is Kelvin Lee. I was raised in Hong Kong and moved to Vancouver, British Columbia, in 2025. I hold a bachelor’s degree in geography from Hong Kong Baptist University and a master’s degree in geomatics for environmental management from the University of British Columbia. My academic background has equipped me with a solid foundation in environmental systems, spatial analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

## Future
I have always been deeply concerned about wildfire incidents on remote islands in BC. Through my map design work with the non-profit organization People Animals Land & Sea (PALS), I have come to better understand the vulnerability of communities living in isolated island environments. Looking ahead, I hope to continue developing my geospatial skills while learning more about the history, people, and culture of the places where I live and work. Every professional experience is not simply a new journey to me but a small step towards making a meaningful contribution.
